photoc - command-line toolkit for photographers

Usage: photoc [global options] <command> [args]
       photoc <command> --help

Commands:
  compress     Compress image files
  exif         Inspect JPEG metadata
  duplicates   Find exact duplicate files
  stats        Summarize JPEG collections
  rename       Preview or apply JPEG renames
  sort         Preview or apply JPEG sorting
  focus        Assess image focus
  scrub        Remove GPS metadata from JPEG copies

Global options:
  -h, --help       Show global or command help
  -V, --version    Show the version
  -v, --verbose    Request detailed output
  -q, --quiet      Request reduced output
      --json       Request JSON output where supported

Exif and stats inspect JPEG files; duplicates compares file bytes.
Rename and sort preview by default; scrub writes new JPEG copies.
Other commands are planned.
Run 'photoc <command> --help' for usage and examples.
